front.title: Privacy and Network Management Considerations for Semantic Sensing Outputs in AI-Native Networks

abstract.t: Radio sensing in ISAC and AI-assisted networks produces semantic outputs such as target position, velocity, class, and identifiers. These outputs can reveal sensitive information about people who take no part in any communication service, especially when they are released repeatedly, combined across sources, or shared across administrative domains. This document describes the privacy risks of releasing such outputs and the network management functions needed to control their release: policy, enforcement at trust boundaries, consumer authorisation, accounting, and auditing. It surveys protection approaches and lists open research questions. It does not define a protocol or an algorithm.
